The applicants have filed this First bail application under Section 482 of BNSS/438 of Cr.P.C. for grant of anticipatory bail.

2. Applicants apprehend their arrest in connection with Crime No.630/2022 registered at Police Station Maharajpura, District Gwalior (M.P.) in relation to the offence punishable under Sections 498A, 306, 34 of IPC.
3.
It is submitted by counsel for the applicants that applicants are Chacha Sasur, Chachi Saans and Jethani of the deceased.
The marriage was performed about more than nine years back.
The deceased was under depression and for that purpose, her treatment was going on.

sentences.text: It is further submitted that the applicants are permanent resident of District Gwalior and there is no likelihood of their absconsion or tampering with the prosecution evidence.
Applicants undertake to cooperate in investigation/trial and would not be a source of embarrassment and harassment in any manner to the complainant party side.

Counsel for the applicants has submitted that the co-accused person namely Sonu @ Yogendra, who is husband of the deceased have already been granted bail in M.Cr.C. No.50076 of 2023 vide order dated 29.12.2023 and the case of the present applicants are akin to that of co-accused, thus, they are entitled to be released on anticipatory bail on the ground of parity also.
5. Learned counsel for the respondent/State has vehemently opposed the prayer and prayed for dismissal of the application.

6. Heard the counsel for the parties and perused the case diary.
7.

Considering the above submissions and facts situation of the case and the fact that co-accused,
who is husband of the deceased has been granted anticipatory bail, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, this Court intends to allow the application, therefore, it is hereby directed that in the event of arrest, the applicants shall be released on bail on their furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- each (Rs. Fifty Thousand Only) with one solvent surety each of the like amount to the satisfaction of Arresting Authority/Investigating Officer.
